file_stem: RWB TE 004 Masked data in SIT and UAT
title: Masked data in SIT and UAT
goal: SIT and UAT tests run on realistic volumes using masked copies, never exposing a real customer
why: Testers need production-sized data with real balances and dates, but PDPA forbids real names and IDs. Any personal-looking value refuses the whole load.
triggers: RW-PLATADM starts the load for SIT or UAT
PII service drops masked extract + manifest
ace_note: No recovery.v_ace_* read. Note: the story still names pre-alignment copy tables (party, loan_account); check against the ACE Data Tier Map when building.
stores: Per-environment intake container (masked extract + manifest); staging schema recovery_next; advisory lock; pipeline load report

functions.name: MaskingVerifier
functions.does: Thai ID check digit, phone, email

rules: BR1: no production data in DEV; SIT and UAT get masked data only
BR3: any personal value left -> the whole load is refused
BR4: balances, dates and keys stay unmasked; totals match the manifest
BR5: the same customer gets the same token everywhere
risks: Totals do not match the manifest -> refused (MSG-P1-002)
Target is DEV or PROD -> refused (MSG-P1-002)
example: Loaded; counts and total_balance per product equal the manifest
